engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Tailgate open warning active on dash
commonCauses: Hatch Closed switch G526 unplugged or faulty
Power or ground supply issue to Hatch Closed switch G526
stepByStepSolution: Confirm connection issues are not present
Test/Değiştirin / Yenileyin: Hatch Closed switch G526
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the   Audi Q5 or  Audi Q7  after repairs in the rear of the vehicle verify the G525 and G526 sensors are plugged in.  These can be found in the  repair manual but the trim surrounding the striker for the rear hatch should contain both switches.
This fault is typically stored in conjunction with 02914 after trailer hitch retrofits and rear bumper repairs/removal.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
